research_summary: No pre-deadline Bournemouth press conference was available for GW37, creating an explicit missing-evidence case for Antoine Semenyo.

sources.title: Why we won't get pre-deadline team news for two clubs in Gameweek 37
sources.citation_excerpt: The Bournemouth and Tottenham Hotspur managers will not face the media until after the Gameweek 37 deadline.
sources.claim_text: No fresh pre-deadline manager team news was available to change Antoine Semenyo's GW37 baseline.
